title: Reconciliation
body:
The algorithm that compares the new [[Virtual DOM]] tree against the previous one and derives the minimal list of real [[DOM]] mutations to apply. It's the "stagehand works out what actually needs moving" step.

A true tree-diff would be prohibitively expensive, so frameworks use heuristics: elements of different types are assumed to produce different subtrees and are replaced wholesale rather than diffed; and children in a list are matched by their `key`. That second heuristic is why a missing or index-based `key` causes React to reuse the wrong elements when a list is reordered — the diff has no stable identity to match on. All of this runs on your machine, in the same renderer process as your own code, before a single real DOM node is touched.
